olmec--maduro.description: Announced by Foundation Cigar Co. in July 2022, Olmec draws on the old Olmec heartland of Veracruz, where its San Andrés wrapper is grown. The Maduro uses the dark negro leaf over a Nicaraguan binder and Estelí and Jalapa filler, rolled at A.J. Fernandez. It is dark and dry-edged, with chocolate, coffee, charred wood, leather and pepper.

thirds.notes: Sweet chocolate and black pepper with baking spice, raisin and cedar; some smokes show a bright orange note.
Coffee joins the chocolate as charred wood, leather and walnut come in and the pepper grows.
Earth and coffee move forward with dark leather and pepper, while the chocolate recedes toward a syrupy close.

olmec--claro.description: The lighter half of Foundation Cigar Co.'s Olmec, shipped in September 2022, uses a Mexican San Andrés claro wrapper given a slow, cool fermentation, over a Nicaraguan binder and Estelí and Jalapa filler aged three years in bales; it is made at A.J. Fernandez. Candied nuts, cinnamon and cedar meet a steady red and black pepper.

thirds.notes: Walnut and cinnamon give a candied-nut start, with milk chocolate, light cream and red pepper flake behind.
Cinnamon and red pepper lead before cedar sweetens; leather, a floral touch and creamy coffee appear.
Damp earth and black pepper with cream, coffee and nuts; caramel and oak come in toward the end.
